## Deferred — September 18, 2026

**Deferred at the product owner's request.** The provider OAuth/API-key setup change introduced in TestFlight 1.0.24 has been reverted in TestFlight 1.0.25 (20260918151913). BYOT should continue using providers already authenticated on the selected OpenCode server. Revisit provider onboarding only after a new product decision; keep this issue open in the later backlog (`priority:p3`).

The feature PR #72 is withdrawn. TestFlight **1.0.25 (20260918151913)** is available to Internal Testers and restores the pre-change app behavior. 1.0.24 was removed from the tester group. [Rollback release evidence](https://github.com/steventsao/byot/blob/codex/revert-provider-auth-testflight/docs/releases/1.0.25/README.md). The older stacked #38 remains historical, unmerged work and is not part of an active release plan.

---

## Priority — September 11, 2026

**priority:p3 — later; outside the table-stakes feature group for this release.** BYOT currently connects to a server with providers configured there. Full OAuth/API-key onboarding expands that setup flow; retain the issue, but prioritize prompt control, file context and recovery first. Existing provider/model selection should not be rebuilt as part of this ticket.

Priorities are a mobile-product judgment based on OpenCode client source inspected September 11, 2026. Current upstream v2 source is pinned to `d6c22b3`; this is newer than BYOT 1.0.15’s validated beta 19271. Implement against each supported server’s actual schema and capability-gate missing operations. A command name alone is not a wire-protocol contract.

---

## Backlog review — September 11, 2026

**Keep open.** The app reads models from providers configured on the server. It has no provider OAuth/API-key onboarding flow. Server HTTP Basic authentication is separate and is resolved in #15. #38 is unmerged.

Checked against submitted **1.0.15 (20260911144503)**, application source [`a936d51`](https://github.com/steventsao/byot/commit/a936d5172cc556388312f0421ccd377175c5cc67); [1.0.15 release evidence](https://github.com/steventsao/byot/blob/87a0a20f8361b8d1fdd6a8e86b7e8776ba8fec6d/docs/releases/1.0.15/README.md). App Store Connect reports **WAITING_FOR_REVIEW** on September 11, 2026. This records implementation and validation, not App Store approval.

---

Add `GET /provider/auth`, `POST /provider/{id}/oauth/authorize`, `POST /provider/{id}/oauth/callback`, `PUT /auth/:id`. Today the app only reads `GET /provider` connected list (OpenCodeClient.swift:228-237) — users can't connect a provider from the device.
